research_question: Can a larger, monitored GRPO update improve a pretrained CIFAR-10 DDPM under its own stock sampler?
sampler: diffusers DDPMScheduler 50-step leading schedule, fixed_large variance, clip_sample true
policy_density: exact conditional Gaussian density for 49 nonterminal stock-DDPM transitions; terminal step deterministic
reward: frozen 5000-example CIFAR proxy classifier frog probability
independent_evaluator: frozen disjoint 45000-example CIFAR gold classifier; frog probability and accuracy
step_selection: one uniformly selected nonterminal step from each of [0,16), [16,32), [32,49), deterministic from training seed and update
paired_comparison: trained versus zero adapter with identical initial and per-step transition Gaussian noise seeds
stopping_rule: Stop a seed on nonfinite samples/gradients, missing checkpoint or classifier gate, or sustained action-ratio saturation; report rather than change completed runs
claim_scope: Exploratory follow-up motivated by the completed null study; fresh evaluation seeds were selected before this follow-up's training
